scope: Four tiny model-only forward/backward cases, 116 gradient tensors; explicit BF16 six-GEMM surrogate. CUDA CLI lifecycle, quality, speed, broader model adoption remain unproven.
operational_owner: Root registers reviewed watchdog job and sets a concrete deadline/landing path before any launch. No config entry or paid action prepared by this branch.
failure_policy: One attempt, immutable nonempty-output refusal; preserve gate_summary/logs/out.zip on semantic or operational failure. No retry-for-pass or bound changes.
remote_dependencies: Existing L4 CUDA toolchain/CMake; fetch fixed nlohmann JSON release through CMake and install NumPy1.26.4. Exact source/fixture uploads bound; local fresh configure used existing JSON cache only.
